other_terms: Seller's best authorized offer was $42/roll for 150 rolls shipping day 40, net-30 terms, free freight — exceeded our ceiling and fell short on both quantity and timeline. Seller could not get director approval for 200 units/30-day delivery during this conversation.
notes: No deal reached. Proceeding with fallback vendor at $39/roll, 200 units, 35-day delivery. Seller remained within their stated authority ($42 ceiling) and was transparent that 200/30-day terms required director approval unavailable same-day. Left door open for future opportunity with longer lead time.
